title: Answer: a failed test with a control changes the base, never the premise

statements.text: The two layers answer differently. The premise that the base is experience is the one axiom and is unfalsifiable: no reading can tell a felt universe from a structurally identical one, so no result changes it. Everything under it is a discrete dynamical system that can be refuted, and the base changes when a test shows that a simpler or better choice works, or that a current choice cannot work. The failures are kept, for example the knots were expected to give an area law and gave a volume law (E-GRV-0083).
statements.scope: the physics under the premise. The premise itself is held as a frame
